Name: Ambrosia Rooftop Restaurant & Bar
NoAvailabilityText: Sorry, this date/time is unavailable for online bookings. Select another or call directly to check availability.
TermsAndConditions:
• Tables will be released without notice for delays exceeding 20 minutes past the reserved time.
• For the à la carte menu, a minimum order of two courses per person is required.
• Online reservations apply to the restaurant only and do not include the bar.
• Access to the Bar area is open, it cannot be reserved and it is subject to availability.
• Ambrosia is a smoke-free environment.
• We cannot guarantee outdoor terrace seating in case of adverse weather or temperatures unsuitable for dining outside. In such circumstances, your table will be automatically reserved in the indoor glass-enclosed room.

Cancellations or adjustments to the number of guests are accepted if communicated at least 7 hours prior to the reservation time. After this period, cancellations, reductions in the party size, or no-shows will incur a charge of 10 Euros per absent guest, applied to the credit card provided as a booking guarantee.
Please note: These terms do not apply to special events or promotions, which are subject to dedicated cancellation policies.

• Il tavolo verrà rilasciato senza preavviso in caso di ritardo superiore ai 20 minuti rispetto all’orario prenotato.
• Per il menu à la carte è richiesto un ordine minimo di due portate per persona.
• Le prenotazioni on-line si intendono esclusivamente per il Ristorante e non si estendono al Bar.
• L’accesso all’area Bar è libero, non prenotabile e soggetto a disponibilità.
• Ambrosia è un ambiente rigorosamente non fumatori.
• Non possiamo garantire i tavoli sulla terrazza all'aperto in caso di maltempo o temperature non idonee per cenare all'esterno. In tali circostanze, il vostro tavolo sarà automaticamente riservato nella sala vetrata interna.

Cancellazioni o modifiche al numero di coperti sono accettate se comunicate almeno 7 ore prima dell’orario della prenotazione. Trascorso questo termine, in caso di cancellazione, riduzione del numero di coperti o mancata presentazione, sarà applicata una penale di 10 Euro per ogni coperto mancante, addebitata sulla carta di credito fornita come garanzia della prenotazione.
Nota bene: Questi termini non si applicano a eventi o promozioni speciali, soggetti a politiche di cancellazione dedicate.
PrivacyPolicy:
Dear Guest, under EU Regulations (n. 679, 2016), your personal data will be processed ethically and transparently for lawful purposes, ensuring your privacy and rights.

Processing, both manual and IT-based, serves the following:

1. Booking confirmation and service provision: Your consent is mandatory; refusal impedes service provision.
2. Compliance with Public Safety Law: Your data will be shared with authorities without consent; refusal prohibits accommodation.
3. Adherence to administrative, accounting, and tax regulations: Your consent is not required; refusal limits service provision.
4. Facilitating future check-ins: Your consent is needed and can be revoked anytime.
5. Sending promotional materials: Optional consent is needed, revocable at any time. You hold rights under EU Regulation (n. 679, 2016), including data access, rectification, erasure, and objection.

Contact our Privacy Manager for queries or to assert your rights.
